13.name: Destruction
13.blurb: Fire, frost and shock — the damage school.

14.name: Restoration
14.blurb: Healing, wards, and turning the undead.

spells.name: Flames

spells.name: Frostbite

spells.name: Sparks

spells.name: Frost Rune

spells.name: Ice Storm
